q: The six Articles of Faith (Iman) in Islam include belief in Allah, Angels, Books, Prophets, the Last Day, and ____. (P6)
explain: Belief in Al-Qadar acknowledges that all events occur by Allah's divine decree.

q: The Caliph under whose leadership the standardized single written text of the Holy Qur'an was compiled was ____. (P6)
explain: Caliph Uthman produced the standardized Mushaf distributed to major provinces.

q: The Arabic term for good moral character, manners, and ethical behavior taught in Islam is ____. (P6)
explain: The Prophet (SAW) stated he was sent to perfect noble moral character (Akhlaq).

q: The Night Journey and Heavenly Ascension of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) is celebrated as ____. (P6)
explain: Isra and Mi'raj was the miraculous nocturnal journey where Salat was prescribed.

q: Prophetic history (P6): Who was Prophet Adam (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the first human being and first prophet created by Allah
explain: Prophet Adam (AS) was the first human being and first prophet created by Allah.

q: Prophetic history (P6): Who was Prophet Ibrahim (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the Patriarch known as Khalilullah (Friend of Allah) who built the Ka'bah
explain: Prophet Ibrahim (AS) was the Patriarch known as Khalilullah (Friend of Allah) who built the Ka'bah.

q: Prophetic history (P6): Who was Prophet Musa (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the prophet who spoke with Allah (Kalimullah) and received the Tawrat
explain: Prophet Musa (AS) was the prophet who spoke with Allah (Kalimullah) and received the Tawrat.

q: Prophetic history (P6): Who was Prophet Isa (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the noble prophet born miraculously to Maryam who received the Injil
explain: Prophet Isa (AS) was the noble prophet born miraculously to Maryam who received the Injil.

q: Prophetic history (P6): Who was Prophet Nuh (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the prophet who built the Ark to save believers from the great deluge
explain: Prophet Nuh (AS) was the prophet who built the Ark to save believers from the great deluge.

q: Prophetic history (P6): Who was Prophet Dawud (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the prophet-king who received the holy Psalms (Zabur)
explain: Prophet Dawud (AS) was the prophet-king who received the holy Psalms (Zabur).
